name: W1041 - Web - Document Converters Governance
description: Intent: Warn-tier user dialog on Web upload into the Unauthorized Document Converter surface at sensitivity floor [2] — prompts the user before corporate documents are uploaded to a non-sanctioned format-conversion service (Zamzar, CloudConvert clones, etc.). Exclusions: excludes domains in Websites_Authorized_Document_Converter_Domains_[is]; tune by adding corporate-sanctioned converters there to suppress dialogs on legitimate document processing.
